problem: Gig and freelance workers often juggle multiple short‑term jobs but lack a simple, offline‑first tool to log hours, track earnings per client, and generate invoices, leading to lost income and administrative hassle.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive web app that lets users add clients, create jobs, start/stop timers, edit entries, and export CSV invoices—all stored locally in the browser with optional cloud backup via manual file import/export.

competitors.name: Toggl Track
competitors.difference: Toggl requires an online account and subscription for full features; GigTime works fully offline and is free for basic tracking.

competitors.name: Harvest
competitors.difference: Harvest is a paid SaaS with team features; GigTime is a single‑user static app with no recurring fees.

features: Add / edit clients and hourly rates
Summary view of total hours and earnings per client
Export data as CSV for invoicing
Local storage persistence with optional JSON import/export

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a paid ‘Pro’ version that adds PDF invoice generation and multi‑device sync via a tiny paid backend; test conversion at 5% of active users paying $4/month.
monetization.free_tier: All core tracking, client management, CSV export, and local storage are free forever.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish repository on GitHub with GitHub Pages enabled
Share on freelancer forums (r/freelance, r/sidehustle) and social media groups
Collect feedback via a simple Google Form linked from the app
potential_customers: Graphic designers handling multiple client projects
Content creators doing short video contracts

marketing_content.tagline: Track every gig, earn every minute.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚀 Introducing GigTime Tracker – the free, offline‑first app for freelancers to log hours, see earnings per client, and export CSV invoices in seconds. No login, no subscription. Try it now at https://yourusername.github.io/gigtime-tracker

tests: Open the app, add a client named 'Acme Corp' with $30/hr, create a job, start timer for 2 minutes, stop, verify that total hours = 0.03 and earnings = $0.90 in the summary.
Refresh the page, confirm that the entry persists via localStorage.
Export CSV, open in spreadsheet, ensure columns: Date, Client, Job, Hours, Rate, Earnings are present and values match the logged entry.
next_improvements: Sync data across devices via a low‑cost backend (e.g., Firebase free tier)
